headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk assessment to provide users with up-to-date security and compatibility information. Leverage machine learning models for predictive analysis of potential issues before installation. Implement a user-friendly interface to display binding.gyp command expansions clearly.
actions: Integrate API calls from huami1314/GestaltX to fetch real-time vulnerability data on npm/PyPI packages, enhancing the risk assessment feature.
Use machine learning models from deepseek-ai/chat-demo to predict potential issues with package bindings and dependencies, providing proactive alerts to users.
Develop a custom visualization tool inspired by FrigadeHQ/yogurt to display binding.gyp command expansions in an easily understandable format, ensuring clarity
